t: Combination key lock box featuring a 75mm wide aluminium body for durability and protection against the elements. Can be wall-mounted for permanent installation. A resettable 4-digit combination provides keyless convenience and enhanced security. A shutter door protects the dials from weather, dirt and grime for added discretion. The pull-to-open door system allows easy one-handed operation, while the internal retention container keeps keys securely in place when the door is unlocked. Compact, lightweight design accommodates multiple house keys. Ideal for Airbnb hosts, rental properties, carers and tradespeople to share secure key access. Mounting kit included.
b: Shutter Door to Protect Dials From The Elements
